title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 01 — Missing mandatory evidence
content: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 02 — Confidence below floor
content: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 03 — Live data conflicts with static knowledge
content: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.condition: Live data conflicts with static knowledge
structured_data.action: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 04 — Duplicate task or event
content: Use the idempotency key and current entity state to suppress duplicate execution while preserving the duplicate event in the audit trail. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Use the idempotency key and current entity state to suppress duplicate execution while preserving the duplicate event in the audit trail.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 05 — Authority exceeded
content: Block execution and request approval from the role specified in the authority matrix, including amount, impact, evidence and rollback plan. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Block execution and request approval from the role specified in the authority matrix, including amount, impact, evidence and rollback plan.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 06 — Customer or supplier impact
content: Before executing a material change, identify affected users, required notice, contractual or privacy implications and a remediation path. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Before executing a material change, identify affected users, required notice, contractual or privacy implications and a remediation path.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 07 — Provider or integration unavailable
content: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 08 — Irreversible action
content: Require two-step confirmation, evidence snapshot, explicit scope and legal or data-owner review where applicable. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Require two-step confirmation, evidence snapshot, explicit scope and legal or data-owner review where applicable.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 09 — Policy ambiguity
content: Do not create an ad-hoc policy through a model answer. Escalate the policy question and continue only with reversible advisory work. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Do not create an ad-hoc policy through a model answer. Escalate the policy question and continue only with reversible advisory work.

title: Strategy, Performance & Evolution rule 10 — Material anomaly
content: Compare against prior baselines, rule out data-quality errors, create an incident if genuine and stop automated amplification. The Strategy, Performance & Evolution agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Compare against prior baselines, rule out data-quality errors, create an incident if genuine and stop automated amplification.
